notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Here's the new Magnytour update! It includes :
-	16 new classic profiles with the same distances and gradients as in real life,
-	Drop-down menu in the lobby for quicker access to your favourite profiles,
-	Full ranking display,
-	Quick chat,
-	Improved dice algorithm,
-	Bug fixes.
Enter the race!
